info.name: Fuel Management System Mid-Term
info.description: Examination requirement requests for the Fuel Management System API. Run in order after the application has started and the empty-database fixture has loaded.

exec: pm.test('Fuel type JSON does not contain attendants', function () {
const fuelTypes = pm.response.json();
pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200);
pm.expect(fuelTypes.length).to.be.above(0);
pm.expect(fuelTypes[0]).to.not.have.property('attendants');
const types = pm.response.json();
pm.collectionVariables.set('petrolId', types.find((type) => type.name === 'Petrol').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('dieselId', types.find((type) => type.name === 'Diesel').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('keroseneId', types.find((type) => type.name === 'Kerosene').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('lpgId', types.find((type) => type.name === 'LPG').id);
const pumps = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Pumps can be listed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pumps.length).to.be.at.least(4); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('pump1Id', pumps.find((pump) => pump.pumpNumber === 1).id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('pump3Id', pumps.find((pump) => pump.pumpNumber === 3).id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('pump4Id', pumps.find((pump) => pump.pumpNumber === 4).id);
const attendants = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Pump attendants can be listed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(attendants.length).to.be.at.least(3); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('attendant1Id', attendants.find((attendant) => attendant.firstName === 'Aline').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('attendant2Id', attendants.find((attendant) => attendant.firstName === 'Eric').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('attendant3Id', attendants.find((attendant) => attendant.firstName === 'Beata').id);
const drivers = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Drivers can be listed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(drivers.length).to.be.at.least(5); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('driverId', drivers.find((driver) => driver.licenseNumber === 'DL-2021-04567').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('driverLicense', 'DL-2021-04567');
const issues = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Fuel issues can be listed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(issues.length).to.be.at.least(10); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('requestedIssueId', issues.find((issue) => issue.status === 'REQUESTED').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('approvedIssueId', issues.find((issue) => issue.status === 'APPROVED').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('dispensedIssueId', issues.find((issue) => issue.status === 'DISPENSED').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('protectedIssueId', issues.find((issue) => issue.issueDate === '2026-10-22').id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('octoberIssueId', issues.find((issue) => issue.issueDate === '2026-10-20').id);
const receipts = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Fuel receipts can be listed', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(receipts.length).to.be.at.least(1); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('receiptId', receipts.find((receipt) => receipt.fuelIssue.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('protectedIssueId')).id);
pm.test('Fuel type save returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel type saved successfully'); });
pm.test('Pump save returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Pump saved successfully'); });
pm.test('Pump attendant save returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Pump attendant saved successfully'); });
pm.test('Driver save returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Driver saved successfully'); });
pm.test('Driver can be found by ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().licenseNumber).to.eql('DL-2021-04567'); });
pm.test('Fuel type can be found by ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().name).to.eql('Petrol'); });
pm.test('Pump can be found by ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().pumpNumber).to.eql(4); });
pm.test('Pump attendant can be found by ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().firstName).to.eql('Aline'); });
pm.test('Fuel issue can be found by ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('requestedIssueId')); });
pm.test('General update succeeds without changing status', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel issue updated successfully'); });
pm.test('Status remains APPROVED after general update', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('APPROVED'); });
pm.test('Driver can be found by ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().licenseNumber).to.eql('DL-2021-04567'); });

pm.test('Case-insensitive last name returns both drivers', function () { const drivers = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(drivers.length).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(drivers[0].firstName <= drivers[1].firstName).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Issues are filtered and ordered by status', function () { const issues = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(issues.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(issues.every((issue) => issue.status === 'REQUESTED')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(issues[0].issueDate <= issues[issues.length - 1].issueDate).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Inclusive October date range returns October issues', function () { const issues = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(issues.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(issues.every((issue) => issue.issueDate >= '2026-10-01' && issue.issueDate <= '2026-10-31')).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Diesel attendants are returned without case matching', function () { const attendants = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(attendants.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(attendants.some((attendant) => attendant.firstName === 'Eric')).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Pump 4 is free', function () { const pumps = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pumps.some((pump) => pump.pumpNumber === 4)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('LPG is unused', function () { const types = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(types.some((type) => type.name === 'LPG')).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('Attendant drivers are listed once', function () { const drivers = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); const driverIds = drivers.map((driver) => driver.id); pm.expect(new Set(driverIds).size).to.eql(driverIds.length); pm.expect(driverIds.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Missing attendant returns the required 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('The pump attendant with that id does not exist'); });
const testDate = new Date(); testDate.setDate(testDate.getDate() + 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 365)); pm.collectionVariables.set('testDate', testDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
pm.test('New issue starts as requested', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel issue saved successfully'); });
pm.test('Past issue returns the required 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel issue date cannot be in the past'); });

pm.test('New issue starts as REQUESTED even if body said DISPENSED', function () { const issues = pm.response.json(); const savedIssue = issues.find((issue) => issue.plateNumber === 'POSTMAN-100'); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(savedIssue).to.exist; pm.expect(savedIssue.status).to.eql('REQUESTED'); });
pm.test('Second issue for attendant and date returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Attendant already has a fuel issue on that date'); });
pm.test('Requested issue can be approved', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel issue status updated successfully'); });
pm.test('Final status cannot move backwards', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Cannot change status from DISPENSED to REQUESTED'); });
pm.test('Missing issue returns the required 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('The fuel issue with that id does not exist'); });
pm.test('Fuel type is added to attendant', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel type added to the pump attendant'); });
pm.test('Duplicate fuel type returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('The pump attendant already has that fuel type'); });
pm.test('Missing attendant returns the required 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('The pump attendant with that id does not exist'); });
pm.test('Missing fuel type returns the required 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('That fuel type does not exist'); });
pm.test('Attendant can be moved to free pump', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Pump changed successfully'); });
pm.test('Occupied pump returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('That pump is taken by another pump attendant'); });
pm.test('Missing pump returns the required 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('The pump with that pumpNumber does not exist'); });
pm.test('Receipt is saved for a dispensed issue', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel receipt saved successfully'); });
pm.test('Receipt for non-dispensed issue returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel receipts are only for DISPENSED fuel issues'); });
pm.test('Missing issue returns the required 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('The fuel issue with that id does not exist'); });

pm.test('Driver receipt history is returned newest first', function () { const receipts = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(receipts.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(receipts[0].receiptDate >= receipts[receipts.length - 1].receiptDate).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Receipt can be deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('Fuel receipt deleted successfully'); });
pm.test('Missing receipt returns the required 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('The fuel receipt with that id does not exist'); });
pm.test('Issue with receipts cannot be deleted', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('That fuel issue has fuel receipts, delete them first'); });

pm.test('Status report returns status and count rows', function () { const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.at.least(4); pm.expect(rows[0]).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(Number(rows[0][1])).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('Bulk update reports the two matching issues', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql('2 fuel issues cancelled'); });

pm.test('Dashboard includes all summary counts', function () { const summary = pm.response.json(); pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(summary).to.have.all.keys('drivers', 'attendants', 'freePumps', 'issuesToday', 'requested', 'receipts'); pm.expect(summary.drivers).to.be.at.least(5); });
